subject: Coordination: upcoming minor VPC/on-prem release, maintenance window and rollback plan
messages:
From: Anya Petrov <anya@greengrid.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: GreenGrid Ops Team <ops@greengrid.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: schedule for minor private deployment patches (v1.3.2)

Hi Marcus,

We have three security advisories (TLS renewal + container runtime CVE mitigations + kernel micro-updates) that we want to roll into the next private deployment for our Redwood Private VPC instance. Our security team prefers a maintenance window next week (May 4-6) during their early-morning hours (02:00-06:00 PT) to minimize user impact.

Can you share your recommended sequencing, and whether we can do a rolling patch without pinning to older model binaries? We also need an explicit rollback plan and the names of any scripts/artefacts you will run.

Attachments: greengrid-advisories.zip (list of vendor advisories)

Thanks,
Anya
Anya Petrov
Platform Engineering Lead
GreenGrid Inc.
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Anya Petrov <anya@greengrid.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: schedule for minor private deployment patches (v1.3.2)

Hi Anya — thanks for the heads up and for including the advisories. We can support a rolling minor release that preserves your model pins, but there are a few constraints to call out up front:

- Kernel-level micro-updates may require a host reboot for on-prem; if your nodes are in a private VPC with strict maintenance windows we'll need explicit approval for reboots.
- If we change container runtime bits, the KV-cache binary compatibility must be validated; we'll stage that in Canary before any prod rollout.
- We prefer a staged rollout: staging -> canary (10%) -> prod (100%), with a fast rollback if errors exceed thresholds.

Proposal (high level):
1) Prep & validation (May 2): upload artifacts, smoke tests against staging.
2) Canary window (May 4, 02:00-03:30 PT): apply infra patches on one AZ / 10% of instances. Run perf+latency checks and sample prompt sets.
3) Prod phase (May 4-5, 03:30-06:00 PT): expand to remaining capacity in controlled batches.
4) Hold & validation (May 5-6): monitor for 48h before closing the window.

Rollback plan (summary):
- If swap threshold hit (error rate > 2% OR 99th percentile latency + 30% over baseline) within a phase, we will:
  a) Stop rollout, revert to pinned container image (we keep last-known-good tag available),
  b) Restore KV cache from prefix snapshot to avoid cache corruption,
  c) Re-route traffic to fallback region/previous model variant if capacity/region configured.

I will attach our maintenance checklist and the rollback script we run for these flows; please confirm whether you want us to perform host reboots or if your ops team will.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 2027-05-01-proposed-checklist.pdf (high level)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Anya Petrov <anya@greengrid.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: schedule for minor private deployment patches (v1.3.2)

Adding a couple of notes from an ops perspective:

- Canary sizing: rather than a flat 10%, do one AZ + a single dedicated canary pool with routing weights (so we can instantly cut traffic if needed).
- Model pinning: If GreenGrid is pinning to a model SHA, we'll ensure the runtime binary is compatible with that model variant. If we see any serializer mismatch we abort before hitting canary.
- DB migrations: there should be zero persistent schema changes in this minor release; if anything is required it must be backward-compatible.

Preflight checks I'd like completed prior to the canary window:
- Snapshot of KV caches and metadata (store with timestamped prefix)
- Health-check baseline capture (p50/p95/p99 on representative prompts)
- Firewall rules snapshot (egress rules and load balancer ACLs)

Anya — can you confirm who from GreenGrid will apply network ACLs (if necessary) during the window? Also: any procurement approvals we should know about?

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Anya Petrov <anya@greengrid.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: schedule for minor private deployment patches (v1.3.2)

Quick technical addendum — rollback runbook (executable checklist):

1) Abort rollout: set route weight of canary pool to 0 and stop the deployment job.
2) Assert health: check 200s on /health and latency buckets; if unhealthy, continue rollback.
3) Container revert: docker pull <last-known-good:tag> && kubectl set image --record "deployment/ri-runtime=last-known-good:tag"
4) KV cache restore: invoke --kv-restore --prefix=restore_20270502 (script attached).
5) Host reboots (if needed): if reboot required, cordon nodes, drain, reboot, uncordon.
6) Post-rollback: run canary smoke suite and post results to linked Confluence page.

I attached rollback-script-v1.sh (bash) and a tiny helper that snapshots and restores cache prefixes. Test these in your staging cluster; they are intentionally conservative.

Priyom
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

Attachments: rollback-script-v1.sh (executable), kv-prefix-restore-helper.py (script)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Anya Petrov <anya@greengrid.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: schedule for minor private deployment patches (v1.3.2)

Security checklist (OpsSec requests):

- Confirm TLS cert rotation plan: if certs are replaced, ensure clients have a 72-hour overlap with old certs to avoid handshake failures.
- Audit/logging: enable debug-level audit for the canary window and ship logs to your centralized SIEM (we recommend a 7-day retention for the debug slice).
- Evidence: we'll produce a short SOC2-style evidence bundle after the window (audit log snapshot, signed checklists, and hash of the rollback artefacts).

Also: if GreenGrid requires us to run the kernel micro-updates, we need signed change approval for host reboots. Otherwise, GreenGrid ops will handle host-level updates and we will run container/runtime changes only.

Soojin
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Anya Petrov <anya@greengrid.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T07:00:00-07:00
Subject: Final: maintenance window confirmed — May 4 02:00-06:00 PT (canary + phased rollout)

Anya / GreenGrid Ops,

Thanks everyone — confirmed for May 4 with the plan below. Please reply if any of the bullets are blockers.

Finalized plan (concise):
- May 2: Prep & staging validation (Redwood + GreenGrid): artifacts uploaded to the QA bucket, KV snapshot taken.
- May 4 02:00-03:30 PT: Canary (single AZ, dedicated canary pool). Debug logs retained.
- May 4 03:30-06:00 PT: Phased prod expansion (batches with 15-minute observation windows).
- May 5-6: Monitoring hold; we will not promote new model binaries in that window.

Network/host responsibilities:
- GreenGrid to perform host kernel micro-updates & reboots (if desired). If GreenGrid elects not to, Redwood can perform but requires signed change approval by 18:00 PT May 3.
- GreenGrid to apply any load-balancer ACL changes; Redwood will only alter routing weights.

Rollback thresholds: error rate > 2% OR p99 latency rise > 30% over baseline. Execution follows Priyom's script.

Deliverables after completion:
- Audit bundle (Soojin will compile), rollback logs and execution timestamps, and the final vpc-change-log-202705.csv.

Anya — can you confirm whether GreenGrid will sign off on host reboots or prefer Redwood to do them with approval? If we don't hear back by EOD May 3 (18:00 PT) we'll assume GreenGrid will handle host-level updates.

Best,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 2027-05-03-maintenance-checklist.pdf, vpc-change-log-202705.csv
